issues.description: The UML in problem_statement.md declares the attributes numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double (problem_statement.md: lines 65-66), but the reference implementation in solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java declares these fields as int (lines 6-10) and the UML also declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with an int return type (problem_statement.md: line 70). This inconsistency (double attributes vs. int return type / int fields in the solution) can confuse students: following the UML they might implement double fields and then have type mismatches with the expected int return values or with the provided solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int so it matches the solution implementation and the getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int signature. Alternatively, if doubles are required pedagogically, update the solution and template to use double for those attributes and change getTotalNumberOfStudents() (and any related method signatures/examples) to return double.
